g.title: agent
g.text: LLM-assisted CI/CD security agent: from push to pull request

g.title: triage
g.text: normalize to (file, line, cwe, message, severity)
de-duplicate across tools, drop below medium severity

g.title: gate
g.text: Validation gate (fresh sandbox run on the patched tree)
- re-scan: same rule / same CWE at >= severity is gone

g.title: pr
g.text: Write PR text, commit to its own branch,
open one PR per finding (GitHub API)
